description: Advisory committees can approve up to $2,000 in spending.
Committees must submit annual budgets by October 1 for Council.
Changes aim for consistent, transparent, and accountable spending.

chips.text: Committees face challenges planning annual budgets due to reactive nature.
Organizations seeking funding from advisory committees are affected by new processes.
How to accommodate ad hoc funding requests in annual budgets was questioned.
Pollinator program funding request highlighted mandate clarity issues.
Administration will provide background on existing grants for funding requests.
